title: Pure Burning Abyss
summary: Burning Abyss cards only, with hand traps and an automatic Extra Deck. The Malebranche are Level 3 DARK Fiends that summon themselves from the hand while you control no Spells or Traps. That's why this list carries hand traps but no staple Spells. They destroy themselves next to any non-Burning Abyss monster, and every one of them does something when it reaches the GY. Graff summons another Malebranche from the Deck, Cir revives one, and Scarm searches a Level 3 DARK Fiend in the End Phase. Farfa banishes a monster until the End Phase, Alich negates one, and Calcab bounces a Set card. Two Level 3s make Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss, which mills cards and recovers a Burning Abyss card when it leaves. Cherubini, the newest card (2019), protects the monsters it points to and mills a Level 3 to trigger more. Virgil spins a card back into the Deck. Beatrice, Lady of the Eternal is Forbidden.
